context.interpretation: A shortfall means annual resources are insufficient. Timing means annual income covers commitments but projected cash still falls below zero before income arrives. A negative monthly income-minus-commitment row is not an actionable gap when existing cash keeps projected cash non-negative. For a shortfall or timing problem, worst month means the most negative monthly_gap_usd, not a later month with the lowest accumulated cash. Cash drag means idle cash exceeds six average months of commitments. Cash-drag and no-problem accounts use no worst month.
context.researchOnly: Synthetic teaching scenario only. This is not investment, tax or cash-management advice.
